name.description: Name for the cron drop-in entry. Used as the file name under /etc/cron.d/ or /etc/cron.{interval}/.

object.description: Name of the uploaded file in the object store to deploy as the cron entry content.

schedule.description: Cron schedule expression (e.g., "*/5 * * * *"). Mutually exclusive with interval — provide exactly one.

interval.description: Periodic interval (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly). Places the script in /etc/cron.{interval}/. Mutually exclusive with schedule — provide exactly one.

user.description: User to run the command as. Only applies when using schedule (cron.d entries include a user field).

content_type.description: Content type: "raw" or "template". When "template", the file content is rendered through Go text/template with agent facts and user-supplied vars.

vars.description: Template variables. Only used when content_type is "template".
